abbott_smith_html:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον),
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;]
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master;
__1. in general: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.9:38 20:8, Mrk.12:9 13:35, Luk.19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Mat.12:8, Mrk.2:28, Luk.6:5; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., Mat.10:24, Luk.14:21, Act.16:16, al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, Eph.6:5, 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), Act.25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, 1Co.8:5; of a husband, 1Pe.3:6; in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Mat.13:27 16:22 27:63, Mrk.7:28, Luk.5:12, Jhn.4:11, Act.9:5, al.
__2. As a divine title (frequently in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT,
__(a) of God: ὁ κ., Mat.5:33, Mrk.5:19, Luk.1:6, Act.7:33, Heb.8:2, Jas.4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), Mat.21:9, Mrk.13:20, Luk.1:17, Heb.7:21, 1Pe.1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Mat.11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, 1Ti.6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Mat.4:7, 10 al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, Rev.4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Rom.9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Mat.1:20 2:13, Luk.1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Luk.4:18, Act.8:39;
__(b) of the Christ: Mat.21:3, Mrk.11:3, Luk.1:43 20:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), Act.10:36, Rom.14:8, 1Co.7:22, Eph.4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jhn.20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, Act.1:21, 1Co.11:23, al.; id. before Χριστός, Eph.1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, 1Ti.1:14, Heb.7:14, al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, 1Th.3:11, Heb.13:20, al.; Χριστός, Rom.16:18; Ἰ Χ., 1Co.1:2, 1Th.1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Rom.1:4, Col.2:6, Eph.3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, 2Pe.3:2; id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., 1Co.7:22, 25 Jas.5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Rev.19:16; with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Col.3:24, al.
SYN: see: δεσπότης. (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title)

occurrences.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

occurrences.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

occurrences.bsb: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
occurrences.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

occurrences.bsb: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her.
occurrences.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

occurrences.bsb: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
occurrences.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”
occurrences.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,
occurrences.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

occurrences.bsb: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
occurrences.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

occurrences.bsb: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
occurrences.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

occurrences.bsb: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

occurrences.bsb: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
occurrences.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

occurrences.bsb: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
occurrences.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

occurrences.bsb: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
occurrences.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

occurrences.bsb: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
occurrences.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

occurrences.bsb: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord”),
occurrences.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

occurrences.bsb: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.”
occurrences.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

occurrences.bsb: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

occurrences.bsb: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.
occurrences.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

occurrences.bsb: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed,
occurrences.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

occurrences.bsb: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
occurrences.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
occurrences.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

occurrences.bsb: One day Jesus was teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. People had come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea, and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal the sick.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

occurrences.bsb: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but do not do what I say?
occurrences.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus went with them. But when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends with the message: “Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

occurrences.bsb: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said, “Do not weep.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

occurrences.bsb: So John called two of his disciples and sent them to ask the Lord, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
occurrences.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

occurrences.bsb: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?”
occurrences.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

occurrences.bsb: Then He said to another man, “Follow Me.” The man replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

occurrences.bsb: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”
occurrences.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

occurrences.bsb: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.
occurrences.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

occurrences.bsb: And He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

occurrences.bsb: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”
occurrences.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

occurrences.bsb: At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
occurrences.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”
occurrences.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

occurrences.bsb: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!”
occurrences.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

occurrences.bsb: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord replied, “you are worried and upset about many things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

occurrences.bsb: One day in a place where Jesus had just finished praying, one of His disciples requested, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

occurrences.bsb: Then the Lord said, “Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

occurrences.bsb: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
occurrences.kjv: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

occurrences.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

occurrences.bsb: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
occurrences.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

occurrences.bsb: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
occurrences.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

occurrences.bsb: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
occurrences.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
occurrences.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

occurrences.bsb: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied. “Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
occurrences.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

occurrences.bsb: “Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,
occurrences.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

occurrences.bsb: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
occurrences.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

occurrences.bsb: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
occurrences.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
occurrences.kjv: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
occurrences.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

occurrences.bsb: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
occurrences.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

occurrences.bsb: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
occurrences.kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
occurrences.kjv: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

occurrences.bsb: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
occurrences.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

occurrences.bsb: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”
occurrences.kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

occurrences.bsb: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”
occurrences.kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

occurrences.bsb: “Where, Lord?” they asked. Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”
occurrences.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

occurrences.bsb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” “Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

occurrences.bsb: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

occurrences.bsb: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
occurrences.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

occurrences.bsb: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
occurrences.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

occurrences.bsb: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
occurrences.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

occurrences.bsb: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
occurrences.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

occurrences.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

occurrences.bsb: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
occurrences.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

occurrences.bsb: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

occurrences.bsb: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

occurrences.bsb: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
occurrences.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

occurrences.bsb: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
occurrences.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

occurrences.bsb: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
occurrences.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

occurrences.bsb: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
occurrences.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

occurrences.bsb: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
occurrences.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

occurrences.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

occurrences.bsb: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

occurrences.bsb: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
occurrences.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

occurrences.bsb: and saying, “The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

occurrences.bsb: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: “I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
occurrences.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

occurrences.bsb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
occurrences.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
occurrences.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

occurrences.bsb: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
occurrences.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

occurrences.bsb: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

occurrences.bsb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
occurrences.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

occurrences.bsb: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

occurrences.bsb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

occurrences.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
occurrences.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

occurrences.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
occurrences.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

occurrences.bsb: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

occurrences.bsb: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
occurrences.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
occurrences.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

occurrences.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

occurrences.bsb: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.
occurrences.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

occurrences.bsb: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, who earned a large income for her masters by fortune-telling.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

occurrences.bsb: When the girl’s owners saw that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them before the authorities in the marketplace.
occurrences.kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

occurrences.bsb: Then he brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
occurrences.kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

occurrences.bsb: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul and Silas spoke the word of the Lord to him and to everyone in his house.
occurrences.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

occurrences.bsb: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

occurrences.bsb: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his whole household believed in the Lord. And many of the Corinthians who heard the message believed and were baptized.
occurrences.kjv: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

occurrences.bsb: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking; do not be silent.
occurrences.kjv: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

occurrences.bsb: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and was fervent in spirit. He spoke and taught accurately about Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
occurrences.kjv: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were some itinerant Jewish exorcists who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those with evil spirits. They would say, “I command you by Jesus, whom Paul proclaims.”
occurrences.kjv: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

occurrences.bsb: This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear came over all of them. So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
occurrences.kjv: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

occurrences.bsb: So the word of the Lord powerfully continued to spread and prevail.
occurrences.kjv: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

occurrences.bsb: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears, especially in the trials that came upon me through the plots of the Jews.
occurrences.kjv: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

occurrences.bsb: testifying to Jews and Greeks alike about repentance to God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
occurrences.kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

occurrences.bsb: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
occurrences.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: When he would not be dissuaded, we quieted down and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”
occurrences.kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ He replied.
occurrences.kjv: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

occurrences.bsb: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
occurrences.kjv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Lord,’ I answered, ‘they know very well that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in You.
occurrences.kjv: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

occurrences.bsb: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Take courage! As you have testified about Me in Jerusalem, so also you must testify in Rome.”
occurrences.kjv: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

occurrences.bsb: I have nothing definite to write to our sovereign about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this inquiry I may have something to write.
occurrences.kjv: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
occurrences.kjv: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

occurrences.bsb: Boldly and freely he proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

occurrences.bsb: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

occurrences.bsb: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him.”
occurrences.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

occurrences.bsb: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
occurrences.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

occurrences.bsb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.
occurrences.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

occurrences.bsb: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord will carry out His sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively.”
occurrences.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: It is just as Isaiah foretold: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.”
occurrences.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

occurrences.bsb: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

occurrences.bsb: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
occurrences.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

occurrences.bsb: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: But not all of them welcomed the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”
occurrences.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

occurrences.bsb: “Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well”?
occurrences.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

occurrences.bsb: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
occurrences.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

occurrences.bsb: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

occurrences.bsb: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
occurrences.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

occurrences.bsb: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
occurrences.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

occurrences.bsb: He who observes a special day does so to the Lord; he who eats does so to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.
occurrences.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

occurrences.bsb: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.

occurrences.bsb: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

occurrences.bsb: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
occurrences.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

occurrences.bsb: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

occurrences.bsb: Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

occurrences.bsb: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. For she has been a great help to many people, including me.
occurrences.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

occurrences.bsb: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
occurrences.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

occurrences.bsb: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
occurrences.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
occurrences.kjv: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.
occurrences.kjv: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
occurrences.kjv: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

occurrences.bsb: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
occurrences.kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

occurrences.bsb: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

occurrences.bsb: My conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. It is the Lord who judges me.
occurrences.kjv: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

occurrences.bsb: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
occurrences.kjv: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.

occurrences.bsb: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, along with the power of the Lord Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
occurrences.kjv: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

occurrences.bsb: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both. The body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
occurrences.kjv: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

occurrences.bsb: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.
occurrences.kjv: And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.

occurrences.bsb: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

occurrences.bsb: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:

occurrences.bsb: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
occurrences.kjv: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

occurrences.bsb: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
occurrences.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

occurrences.bsb: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman. Conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave.
occurrences.kjv: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.

occurrences.bsb: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

occurrences.bsb: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
occurrences.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

occurrences.bsb: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
occurrences.kjv: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

occurrences.bsb: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
occurrences.kjv: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

occurrences.bsb: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?
occurrences.kjv: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?

occurrences.bsb: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
occurrences.kjv: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.
occurrences.kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.

occurrences.bsb: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
occurrences.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

occurrences.bsb: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
occurrences.kjv: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.

occurrences.bsb: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
occurrences.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

occurrences.bsb: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
occurrences.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
occurrences.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

occurrences.bsb: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
occurrences.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
occurrences.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
occurrences.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

occurrences.bsb: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
occurrences.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

occurrences.bsb: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
occurrences.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
occurrences.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

occurrences.bsb: as you have already understood us in part, that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
occurrences.kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

occurrences.bsb: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

occurrences.bsb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

occurrences.bsb: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
occurrences.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

occurrences.bsb: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

occurrences.bsb: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
occurrences.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, through the will of God.
occurrences.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

occurrences.bsb: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the gracious offering we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
occurrences.kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

occurrences.bsb: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
occurrences.kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

occurrences.bsb: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

occurrences.bsb: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
occurrences.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

occurrences.bsb: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
occurrences.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

occurrences.bsb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
occurrences.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

occurrences.bsb: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
occurrences.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

occurrences.bsb: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

occurrences.bsb: All the saints send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: All the saints salute you.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
occurrences.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
occurrences.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

occurrences.bsb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
occurrences.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

occurrences.bsb: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
occurrences.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

occurrences.bsb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
occurrences.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

occurrences.bsb: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

occurrences.bsb: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
occurrences.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

occurrences.bsb: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
occurrences.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

occurrences.bsb: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
occurrences.kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

occurrences.bsb: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
occurrences.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

occurrences.bsb: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

occurrences.bsb: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
occurrences.kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

occurrences.bsb: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
occurrences.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

occurrences.bsb: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
occurrences.kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

occurrences.bsb: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

occurrences.bsb: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

occurrences.bsb: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
occurrences.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

occurrences.bsb: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
