occurrences.bsb: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
occurrences.kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

occurrences.bsb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
occurrences.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

occurrences.bsb: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
occurrences.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

occurrences.bsb: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
occurrences.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

occurrences.bsb: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
occurrences.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

occurrences.bsb: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

occurrences.bsb: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
occurrences.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

occurrences.bsb: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

occurrences.bsb: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
occurrences.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

occurrences.bsb: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
occurrences.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

occurrences.bsb: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
occurrences.kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.

occurrences.bsb: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
occurrences.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

occurrences.bsb: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
occurrences.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
occurrences.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

occurrences.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
occurrences.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

occurrences.bsb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

occurrences.bsb: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

occurrences.bsb: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

occurrences.bsb: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
occurrences.kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

occurrences.bsb: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
occurrences.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

occurrences.bsb: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
occurrences.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

occurrences.bsb: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
occurrences.kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

occurrences.bsb: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
occurrences.kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

occurrences.bsb: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

occurrences.bsb: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
occurrences.kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

occurrences.bsb: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
occurrences.kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

occurrences.bsb: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
occurrences.kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

occurrences.bsb: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
occurrences.kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

occurrences.bsb: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
occurrences.kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
occurrences.kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen. The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
occurrences.kjv: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

occurrences.bsb: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
occurrences.kjv: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

occurrences.bsb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
occurrences.kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

occurrences.bsb: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
occurrences.kjv: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

occurrences.bsb: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
occurrences.kjv: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

occurrences.bsb: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

occurrences.bsb: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
occurrences.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

occurrences.bsb: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

occurrences.bsb: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
occurrences.kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
occurrences.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

occurrences.bsb: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
occurrences.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
occurrences.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

occurrences.bsb: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
occurrences.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

occurrences.bsb: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
occurrences.kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
occurrences.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

occurrences.bsb: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
occurrences.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
occurrences.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

occurrences.bsb: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
occurrences.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

occurrences.bsb: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
occurrences.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

occurrences.bsb: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
occurrences.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

occurrences.bsb: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
occurrences.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

occurrences.bsb: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
occurrences.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

occurrences.bsb: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

occurrences.bsb: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.

occurrences.bsb: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
occurrences.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

occurrences.bsb: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
occurrences.kjv: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

occurrences.bsb: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
occurrences.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

occurrences.bsb: but Jesus became a priest with an oath by the One who said to Him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’”
occurrences.kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

occurrences.bsb: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
occurrences.kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

occurrences.bsb: But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
occurrences.kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

occurrences.bsb: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
occurrences.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

occurrences.bsb: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

occurrences.bsb: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
occurrences.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

occurrences.bsb: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
occurrences.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

occurrences.bsb: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
occurrences.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
occurrences.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

occurrences.bsb: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
occurrences.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

occurrences.bsb: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
occurrences.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

occurrences.bsb: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

occurrences.bsb: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
occurrences.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

occurrences.bsb: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
occurrences.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
occurrences.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

occurrences.bsb: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

occurrences.bsb: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
occurrences.kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

occurrences.bsb: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
occurrences.kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

occurrences.bsb: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

occurrences.bsb: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
occurrences.kjv: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

occurrences.bsb: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
occurrences.kjv: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

occurrences.bsb: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
occurrences.kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

occurrences.bsb: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
occurrences.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

occurrences.bsb: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
occurrences.kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

occurrences.bsb: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
occurrences.kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

occurrences.bsb: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
occurrences.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

occurrences.bsb: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

occurrences.bsb: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
occurrences.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

occurrences.bsb: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

occurrences.bsb: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
occurrences.kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

occurrences.bsb: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

occurrences.bsb: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
occurrences.kjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

occurrences.bsb: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
occurrences.kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

occurrences.bsb: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
occurrences.kjv: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

occurrences.bsb: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
occurrences.kjv: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

occurrences.bsb: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

occurrences.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.” So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.
occurrences.kjv: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

occurrences.bsb: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
occurrences.kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead—those who die in the Lord from this moment on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.”
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

occurrences.bsb: and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
occurrences.kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

occurrences.bsb: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
occurrences.kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard the altar reply: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”
occurrences.kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

occurrences.bsb: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
occurrences.kjv: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and grief and famine—and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

occurrences.bsb: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
occurrences.kjv: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

occurrences.bsb: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

occurrences.bsb: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

occurrences.bsb: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
occurrences.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
